mechanism: Both drugs carry significant risk of photosensitivity and can cause overlapping hepatotoxicity and lipid abnormalities; isotretinoin is highly teratogenic and hydroxychloroquine may increase risk of retinal toxicity when combined.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, implement strict sun protection, regular ophthalmologic monitoring, and monitor liver function tests and lipid panels; ensure robust contraception with isotretinoin.
